verification.notes: Nebius Token Factory's public endpoint card was captured on 2026-07-31. It lists routing key MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-M3, Base flavor, us-central1, $0.30 per 1M input tokens, $1.20 per 1M output tokens, approximately 248 tokens per second, text-to-text modality, 1,049K context, FP4 quantization, tool calling, and reasoning. The card's OpenAI example uses https://api.tokenfactory.us-central1.nebius.com/v1/.

Nebius Token Factory's public endpoint card lists the moonshotai/Kimi-K3 route in eu-north1 with FP4 quantization, a 1,024K context window, tool calling, reasoning, and approximately 120 tokens per second. Unlike the canonical multimodal model, this provider endpoint intentionally exposes text input only.

notes: Nebius currently exposes this endpoint as text-to-text despite the canonical model supporting text, image, and video inputs.
